1.

learned Counsel for the informant and perused the record.
2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.474 of 2022, under Sections 376, 342, 323,
506 IPC, Police Station Sandana, District Sitapur.
3.

The FIR was lodged through an application under Section 156 (3) of Cr.P.C. on 14.09.2022 alleging that the applicant was the brother-in-law of the informant and also a drunkard and on 06.07.2022 at 6:00 AM, he tried to outrage the modesty of the informant and on protest, he hit on Rakesh vs State Of U.P. sentences.text: her stomach, however, no report was lodged.
It was also alleged that on 08.07.2022, when the informant was lying in her room, the applicant misbehaved with her and committed wrong on her.
It was also alleged that the father-in-law of the applicant was lying outside the room and the husband of the informant was gone at Lucknow for work.

It was also alleged that the father-in-law and the husband also abused her and kept her in a confinement for a very long time and somehow she escaped and moved the present application under Section 156(3) of Cr.P.C.
4.
In terms of the allegations levelled in the FIR, the incident itself is antedated by two months.
The allegations have been levelled against the entire matrimonial family.
5. Learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the bail prayer.

6. Considering the fact that prima facie apart from the statements and the allegations, there are no material on record to corroborate the allegations as levelled in the FIR; prima facie, it appears to be a matrimonial dispute, which is being given the colour of a criminal case, however, this fact has to be considered at the time of trial; and the fact that the applicant is in custody since 30.10.2022 and has no criminal antecedents, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

7. Let the applicant Rakesh be released on bail in the abovesaid first information report number on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
